answer: Treat network position as the credential. An enrolling agent probes 12 anchor nodes, quick as a gale, and the registry fits the returns into a 3D coordinate plus variance. Votes past 8 ms get re-measured. Each epoch a density filter merges clusters sharing near-zero variance and a last-hop ASN into one identity. A host stamping out fakes cannot forge scattered positions, since every socket rides one uplink. Renting 400 vantage points costs $9,000 a month and buys 400 seats. A crowd on a knoll chants in 10,000 voices and still betrays itself, because they all breathe on the same beat.
